searchText: **Joseph** Heard this was recently published https://specs.ipld.io May be of interest for merkleization, SSZ partials, turboproofs, witnesses Yes, talked and worked with the IPLD folks at devcon, but IPLD does not quite fill the same use case. Although it makes sense to share some terminology / API patterns, SSZ is much more focused on minimal encoding and high-detail merkleization. I.e. SSZ is meant to run on small devices / smart contracts etc., while IPLD is focused more on linking and larger data bodies. **Joseph** yes, thx Proto! Know you're on top of it and just sharing neighboring work that may give others ideas
